facts.text: Turning field recordings into test environments starts with machine logs containing camera, lidar, IMU and GNSS data, followed by calibration and synchronization.
facts.quote: A[Machine logs: camera, lidar, IMU, GNSS] --> B[Calibrate and synchronise]

facts.text: The field-recording reconstruction workflow reconstructs static geometry after calibration and synchronization, then registers the geometry to site coordinates.
facts.quote:
B --> C[Reconstruct static geometry]
    C --> D[Register to site coordinates]

facts.text: The field-recording reconstruction workflow removes dynamic and transient objects after registration to site coordinates.
facts.quote: D --> E[Remove dynamic and transient objects]

facts.text: The field-recording reconstruction workflow classifies terrain and objects after removing dynamic and transient objects.
The field-recording reconstruction workflow repairs occlusions with explicit geometry after classifying terrain and objects.
facts.quote: F --> G[Repair occlusions with explicit geometry]

facts.text: The field-recording reconstruction workflow creates collision proxies after repairing occlusions with explicit geometry.
The field-recording reconstruction workflow assigns physical and sensor materials after creating collision proxies.
facts.quote: H --> I[Assign physical and sensor materials]

facts.text: The field-recording reconstruction workflow replaces moving objects with controllable agents after assigning physical and sensor materials.
facts.quote: I --> J[Replace moving objects with controllable agents]

facts.text: The field-recording reconstruction workflow qualifies geometry and sensors against held-out real measurements after replacing moving objects with controllable agents.
facts.quote: J --> K[Qualify geometry and sensors against held-out real measurements]

facts.text: The field-recording reconstruction workflow parameterises variants after qualifying geometry and sensors against held-out real measurements.
Given the 2027 schedule, reconstruction-quality machine logs should be collected now, before the final sensor suite is confirmed.
facts.quote: One strategic consequence follows from the 2027 schedule: reconstruction-quality machine logs should be collected now, before the final sensor suite is confirmed.

facts.text: Cameras plus pose data and, where available, lidar create geometric site assets that can later be rendered through whichever 2027 sensor models are chosen.
